title: Hamburg Hauptbahnhof

buildingCutout.basis: Mapped main-station building groups and four overlapping features at the documented east entry canopy. The train track envelope and neighboring buildings remain independent.

groundCutout.basis: Retain the six occupied station floors. Trim terrain and draped paving inside two fitted entrance landings and six frontage walks along the mapped station walls.

terrainReference.basis: One common unchanged standard global field sample outside the WSW Wandelhalle entry. No per-part host offsets,parent-wide artificial plaza or platform/rail flattening.

note: Both clock towers, the train shed, Wandelhalle, and the open Hachmannplatz entrance canopy follow the mapped station footprint. Granite landings and frontage walks fit the sampled host terrain.

apronEvidence.basis: Station walls and public approach lines use standard PMTiles. Landing perimeter heights follow the retained Terrarium field in the viewer. The west and east porches use independent entrance thresholds within one station frame.

canopy.basis: The photo shows adjacent glass vaults, a lower link, and steel trusses over open pedestrian circulation. Four layered PMTiles shapes identify the connected forecourt roof.
